name: signingListAccounts
title: List Signing Accounts
description: List signing keys for the authenticated identity. Pass resolve=true to also report the on-chain addresses controlled by each key (scans the account table, so opt-in).

resolve.description: If true, resolve on-chain addresses whose account key matches each signing key (default false)

accounts.description: Array of entries with publicKey (and addresses[] when resolve=true) for each signing key
